description: The weekly generic run. Practitioner-technical sources plus leadership feeds. Every value here was moved verbatim from the constants in scripts/collect-candidates.mjs, and scripts/__tests__/source-profile.test.mjs pins them — this file is not scratch. Note that `subreddits` currently collects nothing: Reddit's .json routes require OAuth and answer every unauthenticated request with a 403, from any address. The list is retained so this stayed a pure move; a new profile should leave it empty. See docs/ai-signals-pipeline.md, Known source limitations.
